description: GitHub Actions secrets that workflows in this repo may reference. This is the source of truth: the Secret Manifest Guard workflow fails when a workflow uses a secret not declared here, or when a declared env_var is missing from .env.template. Keep this file, .env.template, and the workflows in sync.

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.reason: Auto-provided by GitHub for every run; requires no repo configuration. Included so explicit secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN references are recognized.

secrets.name: RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN
secrets.reason: release-please opens the release PR with this token so validate.yml runs on it (PRs opened with GITHUB_TOKEN are skipped by GitHub's recursion guard). Without it the workflow falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN and release PRs ship without CI. Sync the .env value with scripts/setup.sh --sync-github-secrets.

secrets.name: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.reason: Optional Discord webhook for maintenance and re-adoption workflow alerts. Workflows skip alerts when unset.
